known_pitfall_claim: For every complex z, the solution set {w ∈ ℂ : z = sinh w} equals the displayed logarithmic set.
pitfall_counterexample: Take z=0 and w=πi. Then sinh(w)=(e^{πi}-e^{-πi})/2=(-1-(-1))/2=0, so w belongs to the actual solution set. On the displayed side, z²+1=1, |1|=1, arg(1)=0, hence the logarithm is ln(1)=0. Thus every displayed value is 2kπi for k∈ℤ. Equality πi=2kπi would imply 1=2k, impossible for integer k.
